matchup.title: Matchup 3: Come-in Cider vs Melbourne poopoo
matchup.plan_md:
**Projection: 1,416 to 1,487 as rostered, 45 lower for us than this morning's 1,461.** Three of ours sit Monday, none of them injured:
- **Dejounte Murray:** away after the birth of his son.
- **Paul George** and **Anthony Black:** resting on the second night of a back-to-back.

Their ESPN estimates (4, 4 and 5 Nov) keep them out of the optimiser until then.

**The moves: 3 adds, +93.9, all in VanVleet's slot**, ending the week holding Nurkic (*Rotating* section):

| # | US day | Deadline, Melbourne (ET) | Move |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Thu 5 | **1:00 pm Fri 6** (9:00 pm Thu) | Drop Fred VanVleet, add **Collin Gillespie** (PHX) |
| 2 | Fri 6 | **2:00 pm Sat 7** (10:00 pm Fri) | Drop Gillespie, add **Toumani Camara** (POR), for Fri and Sat |
| 3 | Sun 8 | **11:00 am Mon 9** (7:00 pm Sun) | Drop Camara, add **Jusuf Nurkic** (UTAH) |

- **This morning's plan was the same, except Friday's add was Peyton Watson.**
  - Watson was still questionable on Monday (right hamstring) with no pregame decision found, and Cleveland plays a Fri–Sat back-to-back ([Cavaliers Nation, 2 Nov](https://cavaliersnation.com/2026/11/02/cavs-release-full-injury-report-ahead-of-mondays-matchup-vs-thunder/)).
  - Camara has started every Portland game this season and played 24, 26 and 31 minutes in his last three ([RotoWire](https://rotowire.com/basketball/player/toumani-camara-5987)). Form: 31.0 (5); L7 28.3 (3), L15 31.0 (5), L30 31.0 (5).
- **Gillespie** is healthy and comes off the bench at about 26.5 minutes ([RotoWire, 2 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/article/fantasy-basketball-buy-low-sell-high-week-3-trade-drop-targets-145002)). Form: 31.5 (4); L7 41.0 (2), which is noise; L15 31.5 (4), L30 31.5 (4).
- **Nurkic is the risk.**
  - He was out again Monday (toe) ([Yahoo Sports, 2 Nov](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/spurs-vs-jazz-gameday-betting-153428767.html)).
  - The only timeline is "at least four weeks" from 7 Oct ([CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nba/players/2135553/jusuf-nurkic/fantasy/)), and no re-evaluation result has been found (*ESPN est.* 4 Nov).
  - Decide Sunday's add on Saturday from a fresh `matchup.py` run. The listed Sunday alternatives are each unconfirmed:
    - **Claxton:** out Monday, "isn't ready to appear in games yet" ([NBC Sports, 2 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-02/nic-claxton-hamstring-downgraded-to-out-monday)); *ESPN est.* 4 Nov.
    - **Aldama:** doubtful Monday, "very close" ([Dallas Sports Journal, 2 Nov](https://dallassportsjournal.com/kyrie-irving-doubtful-mavericks-kings-injury-report/)); *ESPN est.* 2 Nov.
    - **Missi:** left knee bone bruise ([RotoWire](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/player/yves-missi-6268)); *ESPN est.* 8 Nov.
- **The 4-add row (+98.7)** gains 4.8 more. It adds Nurkic on Friday and drops him after one game, so it depends on him being cleared by Wednesday.
- **Lineups:**
  - Monday has 9 of ours playing for 10 slots. The empty slot can only be filled by dropping one of the players who are out, and none of them is worth dropping.
  - **Barnes** is questionable Monday at LAC (left hip tightness, "doesn't sound overly serious") ([NBC Sports/Rotoworld, 2 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-02/scottie-barnes-hip-questionable-monday-vs-lac)). Our bench is Duren, George and Black, all out, so nothing can replace him.
  - After Monday, start everyone with a game.
- **Watch for:**
  - **Kawhi Leonard** (ours, IR): Rajakovic says he is "doing well", with the next update on Tue 3 Nov ([Basketnews, 2 Nov](https://basketnews.com/news-258646-kawhi-leonard-injury-update-raptors-coach-offers-promising-news.html)). Haynes says "at least three to four weeks"; *ESPN est.* 23 Nov.
  - **Jalen Duren** (ours, bench): no update ([RotoWire DET](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/news.php?team=DET)); *ESPN est.* 9 Nov.
  - **Trey Murphy III** (ours): available Monday ([NBC Sports/Rotoworld, 2 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-02/trey-murphy-knee-available-monday-vs-memphis)).
- **Melbourne poopoo:**
  - **Anthony Edwards** had arthroscopic right knee surgery on 29 Oct. He is out "up to two months" ([FOX 9, 29 Oct](https://www.fox9.com/sports/anthony-edwards-has-successful-knee-surgery-expected-make-full-recovery)), possibly January per Krawczynski ([Hoops Rumors, 29 Oct](https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2026/10/anthony-edwards-needs-knee-surgery-could-miss-two-months.html)); *ESPN est.* 21 Dec.
  - **Ty Jerome** is off the injury report ([NBC Sports/Rotoworld, 1 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-01/ty-jerome-back-removed-from-injury-report)).
  - **Brandon Ingram** is in the G League for "a few days" ([RotoWire, 1 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/brandon-ingram-injury-assigned-to-g-league-537060)), no timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 8 Nov.
- **Trades:**
  - Snow Time Lakers declined our Brown, Booker and Daniels offers.
  - The Smith Jr., Harden, Brunson and Thompson offers still send Black, and most also send VanVleet. If one goes through, this plan changes.
  - The council's verdict is to keep only Thompson (`council/sessions/20261102-070000-black-offers.json`).
  - Thompson: only HotTakes reports an eye knock on 31 Oct, with no missed time ([HotTakes, 31 Oct](https://hottakes.com/articles/amen-thompson-heads-to-locker-room-with-eye-injury-as-rockets-keep-rolli-ce6532f8-5b8a-492e-bcee-1f930198a956)). Treat it as unconfirmed.
